title: SpumanteDifferentialResult
description: Standardized JSON output schema for Wine vs. Windows VM differential conformance test assertions.

dll.description: Target Wine DLL name (e.g. bcrypt, kernelbase, mfplat).

environment.description: Execution environment that produced this result record.

assertions.description: Ordered list of differential probe records and assertions.

id.description: Deterministic step identifier within the test.

api.description: Win32 / NT API under test (e.g. BCryptGenerateSymmetricKey).

comparison_mode.description: Field-level comparison strategy used by the differential comparator.

last_error.description: Win32 GetLastError() value after the API call.

buffer_hex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal encoding of deterministic output buffer or exported blob.

handle_valid.description: Whether the returned handle/pointer is non-NULL and valid.

handle_alignment.description: Pointer alignment in bytes for handle_state comparisons.

bitmask_mask.description: Bitmask applied during masked comparison mode.

roundtrip_ok.description: Whether round-trip verification (encrypt/decrypt or export/import) succeeded.
